TILECOMPANIONS.HudTooltip: Tile Companions — bind a region, a sound, a light to this tile
TILECOMPANIONS.HudTooltipBound: Tile Companions — this tile has companions (add / re-trace / detach)

Warn.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can bind companions to a tile.
Warn.NoScene: This tile does not belong to a scene.
Warn.NoTile: Select a tile on the canvas first.

Info.NothingToDo: Nothing to create: the tile already has those companions.
Info.BoundTraced: “{name}”: {list} bound to the tile — region shaped on the image's visible outline.
Info.BoundBox: “{name}”: {list} bound to the tile — region on the tile's box (image pixels not readable).
Info.Detached: “{name}”: companions detached (kept in the scene as independent documents).
Info.Retraced: “{name}”: region re-shaped on the image's visible outline.
Info.RetracedBox: “{name}”: region reset to the tile's box (image pixels not readable).

Prompt.Title: Tile Companions
Prompt.Hint: Create companions that follow this tile when it is moved, resized, rotated, flipped, hidden or deleted.
Prompt.Multi: ({n} tiles selected: the same choices apply to each; names are taken from each tile.)
Prompt.Name: Name
Prompt.TraceHint: Region shaped on the image's non-transparent pixels. Unticked: the tile's rectangle.
Prompt.LightColorHint: Leave empty for a white light. Every other setting (animation, angle…) is in the light's own configuration, which opens after creation.
Prompt.OpenSheets: Open the sound / light configuration afterwards
Prompt.UnbindConfirm: Delete the companions along with the link, or keep them in the scene as ordinary, independent documents?

CascadeDelete.Name: Delete companions with the tile
CascadeDelete.Hint: When a bound tile is deleted, its region, sound and light are deleted too. Off: they stay in the scene, unlinked.

AutoRetrace.Name: Re-trace the region when the image changes
AutoRetrace.Hint: When a bound tile gets a new image, its region is re-shaped on the new image's visible outline.

SyncHidden.Name: Hide companions with the tile
SyncHidden.Hint: Hiding / showing a bound tile hides / shows its region, sound and light.
